name: Dead Bug
description: Lower an opposite arm and leg while lying on the back, keeping the trunk steady.

items.content: Start with arms toward the ceiling and hips and knees bent to right angles.
Gently brace and keep the lower back resting against the floor.
Reach one arm overhead and the opposite leg away, stopping before the back arches.
Return slowly, switch sides, and breathe without moving the pelvis.

stages.name: Start
stages.description: Lying on the back with arms vertical, thighs vertical, knees bent to right angles and shins parallel to the floor.

stages.name: Reach
stages.description: Lying on the back with one arm extended overhead and the opposite leg extended above the floor. Other arm remains vertical and other hip and knee remain bent; lower back stays on the floor.
